create.name: Eli Jaxon-Bear
create.bio:
Eli Jaxon-Bear is an American teacher of self-inquiry in the line of Ramana Maharshi. As a young man he spent years looking for freedom across many traditions, sitting in a Zen monastery in Japan and joining Sufi gatherings in Morocco, among other stops. In January 1990 he travelled to Lucknow in northern India and met H. W. L. Poonja, known to his students as Papaji, who had himself been a disciple of Ramana. Papaji recognised his awakening and asked him to go back out and teach.

His meetings, called satsang, combine sitting in silence with direct questioning of the sense of being a separate self. He is also known for the Enneagram of Liberation, his way of using the nine Enneagram types as a mirror for seeing through habitual patterns of identity rather than as a personality test. He founded the Leela Foundation, a non-profit based in Ashland, Oregon, and the Leela School, and holds meetings and retreats in North America, Europe, Australia and New Zealand. His books include Sudden Awakening, Fixation to Freedom, An Outlaw Makes It Home, The Awakened Guide and the memoir The Fire of Love, and he compiled Wake Up and Roar, a collection of Papaji's talks. He is married to the teacher Gangaji.

courses.title: Self Realization and The Enneagram (Stream/Download Video)
courses.description: A recorded talk on how the Enneagram can be used to notice the automatic habits we mistake for ourselves, and to look past them to what is aware of them. It is not an introduction to the types but a companion to other Enneagram study.

courses.title: Truth of Your Nature – Meeting with Eli (Stream/Download Video)
courses.description: A filmed satsang in which Eli argues that chasing a calm state can stall real inquiry. He asks viewers to meet whatever is actually present, including what is uncomfortable, as the way to discover their nature.

courses.title: Staying True – Meeting with Eli (Stream/Download Video)
courses.description: A recorded meeting about where attention goes and what that means for a life. Eli looks at how attention given to the personal story keeps the sense of a separate self going, and invites a turn towards silent awareness instead.

courses.title: Chasing the smoke – Missing the fire (Stream/Download Video)
courses.description: A talk for people who have had glimpses of awakening and then lost them. Eli explains why trying to recreate the feelings that came with a glimpse misses the point, and describes the subtler traps that can follow an opening.

courses.title: Way of the Bodhisattva – A meeting at the Maui Dharma Center (Stream/Download Video)
courses.description: A meeting filmed at a Tibetan Buddhist centre on Maui, where Eli relates the bodhisattva ideal of serving the awakening of all beings to the questions and lives of the people in the room.

free_resources.title: A Raindrop in the Ocean: A Guided Meditation
free_resources.description: A guided meditation from Eli on his school's YouTube channel, free to watch, in which he talks the listener into quiet rest.

free_resources.title: Free 3-part Introductory Enneagram of Liberation course
free_resources.description: A short introductory course in three parts, sent by email after signing up on the Leela Foundation home page, introducing his approach to the Enneagram.

free_resources.title: Eli Jaxon-Bear on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His talks and guided meditations on the Insight Timer app, free to play.
